headline: India's RBI Holds Rates This Month...'Will Maintain Neutral Stance'
summary: The Reserve Bank of India held its benchmark interest rate at this month's monetary policy meeting, in line with market expectations. The committee said it will maintain a neutral stance.
why: The RBI sets India's benchmark policy rate, which influences borrowing costs, the rupee and bond yields across Asia's third-largest economy.
